item.title: GTA 6 Character Switching Will Be Limited During Some Missions, Rockstar Explains New Jason and Lucia System
item.description: GTA 6 will not always let players switch freely between Jason and Lucia during story missions, with Rockstar confirming that the system will change depending on the narrative and circumstances of each mission.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look Features 14 Songs From Phil Collins, Lil Wayne, Depeche Mode And More
item.description: Rockstar Games packed Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look with plenty to dissect, from Jason and Lucia’s criminal partnership to gunfights, driving, side activities, and a suspiciously detailed Florida-inspired world.

item.title: GTA 6 PS5 Preorders Explode After Netflix Special as PlayStation Pulls Further Ahead of Xbox
item.description: Rockstar Games’ 27-minute GTA 6 presentation sent preorders sharply higher, but the biggest winner was Sony.

item.title: GTA YouTuber TGG Talks Rockstar North Visit And GTA 6 Preview: 'A Lot More' Is Still Under Wraps
item.description: Rockstar Games apparently has far more Grand Theft Auto VI information ready to spill than its upcoming Extended Look presentation suggests.

item.title: Rockstar Games Addresses GTA 6 Gameplay Leaks: 'Heartbreaking for Our Team'
item.description: Rockstar Games has finally broken its public silence over the Grand Theft Auto VI leaks that have flooded social media during the past week.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Announced at Gamescom 2026 With September Release Date, Free Upgrade, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC Support
item.description: Geralt of Rivia apparently has no interest in retirement. CD Projekt Red officially announced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered during Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026, giving its 2015 RPG another substantial overhaul more than a decade after release.

item.title: Ubisoft Unveils Rainbow Six Tactics at Gamescom 2026 With Turn-Based Combat, 2027 Release Window for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC
item.description: Ubisoft used Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 to reveal Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics, a new single-player strategy game that trades the reflex-heavy firefights of Rainbow Six Siege for turn-based combat, squad management, reconnaissance, and carefully planned breaches.

item.title: GTA 6 Leak #13 Shows Enormous Vice Beach Crowds, NPC Variety and New Open-World Details
item.description: Another alleged GTA 6 gameplay leak has appeared online, and this time the main attraction is not a shootout, police chase or mission spoiler.

item.title: Rockstar Responds to GTA 6 Leaks as Take-Two Targets Microsoft, Discord, X and YouTube
item.description: Rockstar Games has not issued a conventional public statement about the latest GTA 6 leaks, but its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, has delivered a considerably less subtle response: copyright takedowns, federal court filings and an expanding effort to identify whoever is behind the unauthorized footage.

item.title: IGN Gives Ghost of Yotei Lower Score Than Dragon Age Veilguard, Critics Call It 'Better Than Tsushima' But Fans See 'Disaster Coming'
item.description: The reviews for Ghost of Yōtei, the much-anticipated follow-up to Ghost of Tsushima, landed this week with a chorus of near-universal acclaim.

item.title: Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines 2 Backlash Forces Paradox To Unlock Toreador & Lasombra Clans For Free In Base Game
item.description: Paradox Interactive has reversed course on its plans for Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines 2, bringing two popular clans into the base version of the game after criticism from players who objected to the content being sold as downloadable add-ons at launch.

item.title: Silent Hill F Faces Backlash As Alleged 720p Resolution On $800 PS5 Pro Leaves Gamers In Disbelief: 'Next-Gen or Next Joke?'
item.description: The new Silent Hill F is here (YAY!!!), but wait…

item.title: Third-Party Developers Say Nintendo’s Switch 2 Is Already a Headache
item.description: Nintendo loves a secret. That’s not news. But according to developers, the company might be overdoing it with the Switch 2.

item.title: HIDEO KOJIMA Says Death Stranding 3 Concept Exists: 'I Wrote It'
item.description: Hideo Kojima barely caught his breath after launching Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, and he’s already eyeing what comes next.

item.title: Infinity Nikki’s September Patch Has A Small Feature With A Big Payoff
item.description: Infinity Nikki Version 1.9 is more than a costume change. It’s a systems pass.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Cosmetic Economy Under Scrutiny Ahead Of Phantom Edition Launch
item.description: Battlefield 6 is speeding toward launch with real momentum. Fast matches, clean gunfeel, grounded cosmetics, and the classic Operation Firestorm map all point the right way.

item.title: Team Cherry Issues First Kickstarter Update In Six Years For Hollow Knight Fans
item.description: Kickstarter backers of Hollow Knight are finally getting Silksong codes. Straight from Team Cherry.

item.title: Gears of War Reloaded PS5 Disc Reportedly Missing Full Game Content
item.description: So here’s the twist: Gears of War: Reloaded is rolling onto PS5 with an actual physical disc.

item.title: Genshin Impact 320 Primogems Giveaway: How To Enter On Reddit, Facebook, Instagram, And Telegram
item.description: HoYoverse is dangling 320 Primogems in front of players like a carrot on a stick.

item.title: New Silent Hill 2 Theory Reveals Dark Truth About Save Mechanic
item.description: A Silent Hill 2 Remake player just dropped a pretty wild theory about those eerie red save squares we’ve all been staring at for years.

item.title: Alan Wake 2 Expansion: The Lake House Arrives October 22
item.description: Alan Wake 2: The Lake House is coming in hot as the final DLC for Alan Wake 2, Remedy’s 2023 survival horror masterpiece.

item.title: Halloween Gaming Sale: Save Up to 90% on Popular Titles
item.description: Granblue, Alien and other games are getting massive price drops this week, with some games slashed by up to 90%.

item.title: 2025’s Open World Games: Can Any Challenge GTA 6?
item.description: Twelve years. 6 billion in sales. Countless memes. After all that, Grand Theft Auto 6 is inching closer to release, finally.

item.title: Stellar Blade Fan Creates Eye-Catching Custom DualSense Controller
item.description: A dedicated fan just dropped one of the most epic custom DualSense controllers out there, inspired by none other than Eve’s suit from Stellar Blade.
